summary.en: An exploratory, AI-drafted design (Ren aligned with the direction; nothing built or measured): community software grown through recursive local contracts, durable maintained modules, scoped adoption and, later, self-improving decomposition, tested by cost against tuned rivals. The account names it only as an application, correspondence not established (05 §11), and carries neither its founding idea nor any cost or scaling law. It does hold forms of the folder's limits: local plans failing jointly, descriptions keeping plans only under matching conditions, merged summaries, reviewers under one cause, unfunded migration, evidence reopened by change. Divergences kept: authority taken as given, competitive superiority as the goal, a ledger that reads prices, continuity held without premises, everyone happily growing it. No contrary reading found; looked for one.

name.en: Local reasoning is the scaling unit

source.locator: Core claims, claim 1

sense.en: Design direction, from Ren's framing: an agent works from its own module, its parent's requirements, the exposed contracts of neighbours and common architectural rules, and this locality is what lets the swarm scale, independently of any present harness. Locality is meant as the information and obligations a maintainer needs, not directory structure.

entries.quote: Local reasoning is the scaling unit.

reading.en: The claim is that such locality suffices to organize a swarm and is what makes it scale. The account states neither. It has a limit (a claim is excluded only through what couples in) and counter-forms (each within its own count, jointly in excess); the conditional is the next entry. Reading neighbour contracts as couplings is a modelling step no one has taken. [AI reading]

searched: live account: swarm, scal(es|ing) with, coordination cost, overhead, span of control, worker, multi-agent, hierarch, local reasoning

name.en: Local work composes only where the boundary is sufficient

source.locator: Core claims, claim 2; Responsibilities and contracts

sense.en: Conditional mechanism: each parent must supply what its children assume and show that their guarantees plus its coordination fulfil its own contract, recursively. Common prompts cannot substitute for missing dependencies or contradictory requirements. A child can report infeasibility upward.

entries.quote: Local work composes when the boundary supplies sufficient information.

reading.en: The account has this conditional form, and recursively. Joint plans compose given projection and compatibility, and compatibility is also necessary; the supported-start obligations are rely-guarantee in style, the source's assume-guarantee family; a decomposition lifts through a description, and finite trees of joinings lift, exactly under matching conditions. These are process laws: applications must establish the premises, and correspondence to software contracts is unshown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every joint step projects onto a step of each part, the joint class lies over classes the parts' plans keep, and the plans are compatible, the zipped joint plan keeps both guards; conversely every joint plan keeping a guard is compatible. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.

Theorem (any process; periphery): with faithful projections, valid local plans, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid. These are supplied, not shown of actual activity.

Theorem (any process): the parts read through a description lift from every configuration it describes exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies. Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.

Theorem (any process): a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame; where it lifts, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. No shared nodes, cycles or copying of resources; nothing of actual scheduling.

account_adds.en: The converse (a joint plan keeping a guard is compatible), the separate obligation of availability, and that finite trees are covered only without shared nodes or cycles, which is where the source's strict-tree question begins.

source_adds.en: What a contract must contain (units, effects, failure, progress, resources), a parent as the one who establishes composition, feasibility findings moving upward, and that shared prompts cannot supply missing facts.

name.en: Plausible local promises can fail jointly

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion

sense.en: Retained counterexamples: local latency promises do not imply a system deadline unless a parent accounts for the composition, and children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces, so progress needs its own argument.

entries.quote: Children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces.

reading.en: This is the source's closest match in the account. Two locally fine plans fail jointly on one shared reserve; reciprocal promises can be empty; preservation does not give availability; a circular dependence can be a wait no one can begin; waiting relations have exact laws. Same mechanism, on stated models, for the deadlock half. The latency half has no counterpart beyond draws on a stock. [AI reading]

says.en: Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step (periphery, propext and Quot.sound reported), and serialization without renewal does not repair it.

Theorem (periphery): 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens; a law with no successors keeps every property vacuously; in the exchange witness one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.

Theorem (any formations, any relation of waiting): with memory, one withholding, where every formation lies within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on; under both laws more waiting gives no more at any step. In a ring of three a source giving first brings all to give from step 3. It does not show how waiting forms.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions under which a circular wait starts or never starts, a source giving first as what breaks it, and that serializing does not repair an unrenewed shared reserve.

source_adds.en: The latency case and any time budget allocated through a composition, and the design answer, a parent accounting for the actual composition.

name.en: A dependency left off the diagram is still a dependency

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion; ARCHITECTURE section 1

sense.en: Declared boundaries do not make actual dependence disappear: a shared store reached outside them binds the modules anyway. The later plan adds that runtime mediation constrains observable access but cannot establish a concept was completely specified, and that an observed undeclared dependency becomes a repair obligation.

entries.quote: A shared database accessed outside declared boundaries is a dependency even when omitted from the diagram.

reading.en: The account separates a represented region from actual dependence: a draw judged over a region omitting a required condition can lose its own support. A second form fits closer: a writer outside the interface leaves the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. The first concerns conditions drawn on a flow, and a database read is not consumed, so the match is to omission, not depletion. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Instance (periphery): finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrites keep actual coverage; an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied, not shown.

account_adds.en: That a sufficient region for oneself still leaves others undermined, and that a record-only acceptance cannot exclude an extra writer.

source_adds.en: Detection and repair of the hidden dependency by traces and consumer declarations, and treating an observed one as an obligation; the account leaves how a center represents its region unmodelled.

name.en: Can a contract summarize enough without becoming the whole program?

source.locator: Questions, 2; Proposed tightening

sense.en: A parent reasons from a child's exposed contract as the summary of its subtree. The folder's assessment names the main gap: finding and keeping compact, sufficient boundaries through unforeseen changes, or complexity just moves into the contracts or a central coordinator. Stated as an open question, not a result.

entries.quote: Can contracts carry enough meaning without becoming the whole program?

reading.en: A contract as a description: the plan-lifting law says exactly when reasoning at a description is reasoning at everything so described, and the readout law when a reading survives a reduction. Both are relative to given plans or readings and read correctness of leaves as a premise. Whether a compact description exists, or stays compact under change, is untouched, and that is the folder's question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where configurations a description identifies match parts and the leaves are read correctly through it, a finite plan is realized at a description exactly where it is realized at each configuration so described. A witnessed plan does not make arbitrary designated parts composable.

Theorem (any type): what an observable reads through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two configurations a reduction merges. The record notes the loss is at the reduced interface, not universal: retaining the joint relation reverses it.

account_adds.en: An exact criterion for a sufficient description relative to one plan or reading, with history-reading decoders not excluded (03 #r-control-coherence-loss's run form).

source_adds.en: The question that matters to it: growth of the summaries over time, whether complexity moves to a central coordinator, and a mechanism that discovers and revises boundaries under change. None is stated.

name.en: Neighbour-only discovery does not find the globally best

source.locator: Discovery and generation

sense.en: A module requests a capability through its parent and a hierarchical directory routes searches through advertised summaries. Summaries can be stale or incomplete, a semantic match only retrieves a candidate, and compatibility still has to be checked.

entries.quote: neighbor-only discovery does not guarantee finding the globally best implementation without broader search

reading.en: Only the negative half has a form here, and through the source's own two causes: what is alike through what couples in is selected alike (incomplete summaries), and a reference changing without entering what is retained cannot be resolved from that view (stale ones). The account says nothing on search or retrieval, and 'best' is the source's frame, read by its resolver's criteria. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

Theorem (periphery; the histories, moves and local closure supplied): where a reference changes without entering what is retained, two histories share their view while their present answers differ, and no deterministic policy choosing from that view resolves them in finitely many steps.

source_adds.en: The discovery design, broader search as the remedy, and the distinction between a retrieval match and checked compatibility.

name.en: Unrelated growth has small marginal cost; three kinds of scale are separate

source.locator: Core claims, claim 6; soundness assessment table

sense.en: A prediction to test: interaction cost follows active dependencies and change effort follows affected contracts, not installed apps. No constant-cost guarantee for active workloads or shared invariants. Dormant catalog, concurrent agents and accumulated semantic dependence scale differently, and the third is called the largest unanswered question.

entries.quote: Unrelated growth can have a small marginal cost.

reading.en: The account has no law of cost in change effort, attention or computation as a system grows. 'Falling dormant' is a dependence's alteration (01), not an inactive module, and is another mechanism. The folder's prediction was not run and the account does not test it. Not a defect: this is an engineering hypothesis. [AI reading]

name.en: Reserved resources and attributed cost keep growth local

source.locator: Common runtime and limits

sense.en: Performance under growth needs active design: lazy activation, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources and cost attributed to module versions; maintenance needs owners, budgets and bounded dependencies. A thousand dormant apps and a thousand active simulations are different workloads.

entries.quote: Performance requires lazy activation, cached artifacts, bounded queues, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources, and attribution of cost to module versions.

reading.en: Only the reservation has a form here, nested as the source's tree is: parts' footprints within their whole's and apart keep leaf requests covered by the root's, and the joint draw within capacity; without a division each can stay within its own count and jointly exceed. On a balanced flow, not shown of an actual division. Data ownership has no match, because a record is not drawn down. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): where takes are what leaves of a realized joint plan draw, footprints within their whole's and apart and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given; with such a division at every step the level never falls below its start. Not shown: that an actual division is so, or that the level rises.

Theorem (any process): where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.

Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic restating the commons and overshoot, not who ought to take less.

account_adds.en: The exact reason a partition protects a shared stock, with the balance premise named.

source_adds.en: Lazy activation, queues, subscriptions, attribution of cost and all the performance engineering.

name.en: New features create options before obligations

source.locator: Starting position

sense.en: A working commitment: growth should add useful possibilities without imposing runtime cost, maintenance burden or design preferences on every member, so adding should generally widen what members can do while binding no one else.

entries.quote: New features should usually create options before creating obligations for everyone.

reading.en: The account says exactly where a part's added options widen the whole: within others' margins, otherwise the comparison is mixed and unordered, and at a need met exactly any net draw is mixed. A ranking then needs C (order), with the continuation condition fixing whose losses count; neither asserted, warrant open. The law is about draws on conditions, not software burden, so correspondence is unshown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside it, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one; with a need met exactly, any net draw on that condition makes it mixed. Mixed is not ordered.

account_adds.en: The exact edge at which an addition stops being a widening of the whole, and that no ordering holds past it without a further premise.

source_adds.en: The product default itself, and the claim that software's maintenance burden can in practice be kept off non-users.

name.en: Changes have audiences: personal, group, community

source.locator: Core claims, claim 5; Change and adoption

sense.en: Value stance and product direction: adoption is scoped. Different views can share authoritative records; a shared commitment requires the relevant community decision; a forked view does not silently change an official outcome.

entries.quote: Changes have audiences.

reading.en: Formal shapes match in part: agreement kept in a group through hearings closed for it; an imposed code costing each exactly the distinctions it merges, the kind of loss personal variants avoid; a rule whose every change is located at a gated adoption, with a fork keeping its source. All supply the rule of adoption and threshold. None reads personal variants over shared records. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; further premises named): a group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it. An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that it merges, the source losing none. The reading of 05 §9 says none of this tells whether a code supports or damages 生生.

Theorem (any process): a course that changes a gated quantity passes the gate. In a declared rule protocol only adoption is gated, every change of rule is located at an adoption using a recorded proposal, and a fork keeps its source as one branch. Supplied: seed mandate, proposal content, participation, compliance; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.

account_adds.en: That a rule's change has an exact location in a history, that no function of counts gives the decision in that protocol, and that an imposed code loses nothing for its source.

source_adds.en: Audience as a design axis; views forking over one authoritative record; a personal change needing no agreement. The account states no law of shared records with plural interfaces.

name.en: Owners and delegated authority taken as given

source.locator: The user experience; also ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5

sense.en: An assistant proposal: every module has a responsible owner, members adopt within their authority, shared commitments follow delegated authority, and communities retain control of them. The folder keeps the mechanism for representing authority apart from any governance policy and leaves rules undecided; authority is delegated, so relational, but what delegation settles is taken as given.

entries.quote: A change to a shared commitment follows the authority already delegated by the community

reading.en: The account derives no authority: a description of participation confers none, and where authority enters a law it is a supplied premise, as the seed mandate is. So it gives only under a hypothesis what the design uses as a working term. The divergence is narrow, since the folder too leaves who may decide open. 'Owner' would need naming as the relation meant, here who maintains. This does not say the design is wrong. [AI reading]

says.en: Wording names the relation it means: the formation and change of conditions, dependence, participation in decisions. It keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations. A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.

In the declared protocol: seed mandate, recognition and copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed. Duplicate votes do not create mandates.

Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, J1-J4, correspondence and improvement witnesses, none asserted): under these premises it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; it does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority.

account_adds.en: A demand that wording not confer standing, and authority named as a premise wherever a theorem uses it.

source_adds.en: A working use of authority in adoption decisions, including what to do when delegated authority does not settle a question: ask for a domain decision.

name.en: One name, two meanings: attendance

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Matching types do not establish matching meaning. In the worked case one event name conflates observed check-ins and qualification under a policy, and separating them forces downstream changes to badges, eligibility and rewards. An unchanged signature does not count as unchanged meaning.

entries.quote: A calendar and badge module can agree on types but disagree about what counts as attendance.

reading.en: A code is a map from senses to forms: a form held at two senses reads back wrongly (homonyms harm), and a merged distinction returns only by a coined form or one held outside. That is the shape of splitting one event name into two concepts. The law is on one code; two modules holding one form at different senses is a further step of mine. Records do not show actual conventions form this way. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense, and only it, exactly where no two senses hold one form: synonyms do no harm and homonyms do. Where all hold a code merging two senses, a coined form heard by all makes every formation tell them apart again.
Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

account_adds.en: The exact law that synonyms are harmless and homonyms harmful, and who loses what under an imposed code.

source_adds.en: What the change does downstream: retroactive corrections, rewards already spent, and which historical commitments can stay stable.

name.en: A shared decision cannot be made local or derived

source.locator: Assistant, the attendance chain; also README counterexamples and ARCHITECTURE worked revision

sense.en: Architecture can expose relationships but not dissolve shared disagreement. Modularity cannot make every global change local, shared policy disagreements still need social resolution, and whether to preserve, reconcile or compensate spent rewards is a community decision an LLM cannot derive from types.

entries.quote: It cannot make an inherently shared decision purely local.

reading.en: The formal side: mixed comparisons are decided both ways by positive weightings, and a statement reading no order fixes none. Ordering needs C, the continuation condition fixes scope only; neither asserted, warrant open, and C too is silent on mixed cases. That the spent-rewards choice is mixed, and that types read no order, are my readings. Who decides, and how, the account does not say. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission): one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings.

Two premises, neither asserted: the continuation condition (scope) fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C (order) ranks a course above every course it widens and does not rank mixed comparisons. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails: a frame fixes no order.
A resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on; premise: records written to offer exactly what was resolved, read by later cohorts.

account_adds.en: An exact reason the decision is underdetermined, on listed items and weightings, and when a recorded resolution comes to rest.

source_adds.en: The practical move: predict the wider scope before implementation, and the claim that disagreement over shared policy needs social resolution.

name.en: The maintained module outlasts the agents who work on it

source.locator: The organizing model; README The maintained module

sense.en: A durable module holds identity, contracts, state, evidence and maintenance knowledge; workers come and go. Another agent must be able to resume from durable context without reconstructing the whole community's chat, and durable responsibility stays distinct from the temporary task graph of a change.

entries.quote: An executing agent is temporary.

reading.en: The map's thesis is general: a pattern goes on while the occurrences carrying it begin and end, a practice through its members, read at two classes; the thesis is argued, not a theorem. Practice and rule-handoff laws give one protocol where a practice passes on through records. Neither concerns software agents or context reconstruction; correspondence unshown. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis, claimed and argued, not a theorem: a pattern goes on while the occurrences carrying it begin and end: a flame through its fuel, an organism through its cells, a practice through its members. Read at one class, turnover that sustains and turnover that ends look alike; at a fine and a coarse class together they differ.

Theorem (periphery; task, records, mandate, participants and more supplied): a practice round by a reviewer and a worker completes under exact presence and method conditions and installs the method. It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance.
In one declared history, handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate.

account_adds.en: That persistence is relative to a chosen pair of classes, and that a kept rule still needs continuing participation.

source_adds.en: The maintenance dossier as a design, wake conditions, an identity held in records through stretches when no worker is active, and that durable context lets a new worker resume cheaply: not stated.

name.en: Evolution has to pay for its migrations

source.locator: Core claims, claim 7; soundness assessment; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Versions, migrations, ownership, budgets and consolidation belong to normal lifecycle. Features may get cheap while their shared meaning becomes expensive to maintain; a variant budget must include adapters and migrations, and extraction cost is counted before later savings. The folder says owners and budgets are not yet shown to control the burden.

entries.quote: Easy generation alone is insufficient.

reading.en: Two laws have the form: a budget covering correction alone does not pay for migration, with a missing part stopping realization while an aggregate reads safe; and support during a transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings. Both on market models, parts and conversion supplied. The record's own AI reading calls succession the migration of a running service. Maintenance of many forks has no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery): under a certificate covering correction plus migration and the listed conditions, every finite successor takes its step; in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration. Not shown: that an actual system is so provided for, or that a succession is warranted.

Theorem (every law with admissible disturbances and a guard; the cover on the market instance): a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. On the instance: sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law): inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

account_adds.en: That the shortfall can be invisible in an aggregate safety reading.

source_adds.en: Consolidation of forks, ownership transfer, human clarification as a maintenance cost, and the economic claim that generation cost and maintenance cost diverge.

name.en: Rollback does not undo writes; transitions must survive interruption

source.locator: Change and adoption; ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5

sense.en: New implementations are published as versions. Persisted state needs a compatible transition or migration, active sessions and jobs need handling, and cross-module changes need durable transitions with retries and specified compensation. A rollback candidate must account for state already transformed; the plan refuses to promise general atomic rollback.

entries.quote: Code rollback does not by itself undo incompatible data writes or external effects.

reading.en: The refusal has a form: under a fixed law a possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists, and reinstalling an old rule can fail again. The significance chapter has protocols carrying a change through interruption, with limits matching the source's caution: coherence is not harmlessness, completion needs reserve and an uninterrupted suffix, a request's continuing appropriateness is not shown. Stated for alignment, not community software. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): along a finite trace under a fixed law, every existential endpoint possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists; failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint, which, in a witness, incomplete questions hide.

Theorem (periphery; pre-spine modules): in a finite replacement history, returns enter maintenance, failure allows an affordable proposal, and reinstalling the old rule can fail again. None of this is a population or ethical theorem.

Law (any process; pure core) with a periphery instance: a law doing one unit of a pending task's work a tick finishes in that work plus one tick; under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes, leaving the rest unchanged. That the request is still appropriate is not shown.

Instance (periphery): with durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes.

account_adds.en: Exact step counts for resumption, and that consistency alone does not supply reserve, deadline or an uninterrupted suffix.

source_adds.en: Coexisting versions over shared records, migration of stored meaning, spent rewards and compensation, activation pinned against other owners' old promises.

name.en: Retiring a thing while keeping its records and obligations

source.locator: Questions, 6; ARCHITECTURE section 5

sense.en: A module can end as executable software while its history and continuing obligations survive: identify dependents, stop new work, resolve obligations, transfer ownership, preserve records. Compression must not delete unresolved obligations.

entries.quote: The system needs a way to stop maintaining executable variants while preserving community history.

reading.en: The account has endings, bounded recorders that cannot keep a whole history and go on, and a reserved exit that stops reliably, but no law of deliberately ending an activity while discharging what depends on it. 'Retired' occurs only for labels of the repository itself. The repository's practice of moving superseded text to history/ has this shape, but stands in AGENTS.md, not the live account. [AI reading]

name.en: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity

source.locator: Core claims, claim 8; Three properties

sense.en: Value stance: conversations, identity, commitments, decisions and cultural history matter alongside features and performance, and a new version should keep the relevant records and commitments. Social harmony is called an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee.

entries.quote: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity.

reading.en: The source holds as a value what the account gives only under premises: that these losses count is the continuation condition's scope, a ranking needs C; neither asserted, warrant open, and no law says a loss of records is a harm. Same word, other reference: 'continuity' here is records surviving an upgrade, while the account's continuation is relative to a class read, so which class is the source's choice. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; it ranks nothing. C, widening what can form is better, ranks a course above every course it widens and does not rank mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

Theorem (root): for every carrier and relation, continuation is contained in 缘; under the full class continuation is 缘 itself, and under a coarser class every continuation remains one. Its only hypotheses: each class an equivalence, and equality on the carrier where identity serves as a class.

account_adds.en: The split between whose losses count and which course ranks higher, and that what continues is relative to the class read.

source_adds.en: The concrete objects of continuity (identity, decisions, cultural history) as what must survive an upgrade, and a stance held rather than conditioned on named premises.

name.en: Agreeing agents are not independent evidence

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; RESEARCH-AGENDA question 7

sense.en: Independent agents may reproduce one misunderstanding, an agent can write code and tests sharing a mistaken assumption, and review does not establish correctness merely because agents agree. Verification should scale with the scope and consequences of a change.

entries.quote: Agreement and implementation-shaped tests are not sufficient evidence of correctness.

reading.en: The account's reviewer laws have this shape: readiness counts independent root causes; moving two reviewers under one cause fails it with all names kept; a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails them all though the roster reads ready, which is the shared misunderstanding; copies change no certificate. Agents agreeing without copying fall under the cause law only if a common cause is supplied. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core, no axiom; fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers): reviewers count by independent causes, not names. In computed cases three reviewers with distinct single causes are ready, moving two under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept, and a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer.

Theorem (any type, no axiom): where each added witness copies one already on the roster, inspection takes exactly the same steps and gives the same certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.

Theorem (periphery; much supplied): the round completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does. Separation of reviewer and worker is a condition of this model, not a result about correctness.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition: nonempty bounds, every two leaving a reviewer working under both.

source_adds.en: Implementation-shaped tests as a specific failure, adversarial and contract-derived checks, and verification effort scaled to consequences.

name.en: Evidence holds under its premises and needs renewal

source.locator: Sections 2 and 4

sense.en: An assistant proposal: evidence binds property, revision, assumptions, environment and method. Tests expire with code; a compositional argument may stay reusable when a change re-establishes exactly its premises. Tests cannot be summarized up into a proof. Reuse is proposed to make later changes cheaper.

entries.quote: Every reuse records the premises and environmental conditions on which it relies.

reading.en: The account has the negative form: a record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong; evidence must be carried through admitted change; and an old envelope reused after reviewers merge accepts what a recomputed one rejects, the source's stale reuse exactly. A rule that never answers falsely must abstain where a reference changed outside what is retained. The saving from reuse is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; the histories, moves and local closure supplied): where a reference changes without entering what is retained, no deterministic policy choosing from that view resolves them in finitely many steps, so a rule never answering falsely must abstain. A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong.

Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): what execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change; a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.
Computed case (pure core): the old envelope reused after the merger accepts the two merged supporters, a recomputed one rejects them.

account_adds.en: That inspection is needed for repair: reopening and taking up without inspection does not repair the judgment.

source_adds.en: Evidence classes with different invalidation rules, a periodic independent broader check, and the economic case for reuse.

name.en: A change compiled into a repair frontier

source.locator: Section 2

sense.en: A proposed planner: consumers of a changed promise receive a delta through declared boundaries and each decides whether its guarantees still hold; propagation stops at a supported boundary or a broader owner. A revised premise reopens an obligation. Predictions are kept so locality is measured, and exhausted budgets stay unresolved.

entries.quote: a budget limit never converts unknown compatibility into acceptance

reading.en: The planner is not in the account, but three of its rules have forms: what needs certifying is propagated through every admitted change, and a change can reopen what was excluded (a revised premise); an understated change leaves false confidence (a hidden assumption); exhaustion keeps a task pending and does not complete it (a budget limit). These read arrangements and tasks, not consumers of promises; correspondence unshown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): what execution needs certified is the candidate set propagated through every admitted change, a later report filtered only after expanding through admitted fault and control transitions; a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement, and a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.

Law (pure core) with a periphery instance: a course of draws on a stock is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing; with review drawing one unit and action two, an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course; refusal or exhaustion keeps the task and the work used.
Theorem (periphery; moves and closure supplied): a rule never answering falsely must abstain where a reference changed outside what is retained.

account_adds.en: That abstaining is forced, not merely prudent, for a sound rule on that view.

source_adds.en: Propagation of a semantic delta through consumers' declared boundaries, its stopping rule, escalation to a broader owner, and keeping predictions so that locality is measured rather than defined afterwards.

name.en: The decomposition itself must be revisable

source.locator: The capability we must invent and demonstrate; ARCHITECTURE section 3

sense.en: The updated ambition, in assistant-authored mechanisms: work reveals an insufficient boundary, agents propose better ones, candidates are scored with migration cost, later unseen work tests them. The current structure is useful organization, not an assertion that the first decomposition was ideal.

entries.quote: This makes the original responsibility tree an object of learning.

reading.en: The revision step has a form: a rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan, a rule not reading failures leaves one unanswered, and a plan change keeps old selections exactly where it retains old contacts. On organization, the account gives no fixed one a prior claim; any ranking there is C's, under the two premises, neither asserted. Learning its own boundaries, and that it saves later cost, is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; contacts, targets and revision rule supplied): a change of plan keeps every old selection exactly where it retains every old contact; a revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan; a rule not reading failures leaves one unanswered at every plan where no list holds every address. One finite history does not show revision corrects every failure.

Reading [AI, any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: the laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow; whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

account_adds.en: That reading failures is necessary for a revision rule to answer them, and what a change of plan keeps.

source_adds.en: The search itself: bounded local operations (split, merge, extract, move), scoring, cooldowns, and promotion by trial on unseen changes.

name.en: Future costs follow from the current representation

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass

sense.en: The plan's thesis: if a system improves its boundaries, named concepts, procedures and evidence, later work gets easier, and extra experience should sometimes reduce the reasoning the next task needs. Called the central proposed advantage; explicitly falsifiable if search costs exceed savings.

entries.quote: many future costs are consequences of the current representation of a problem

reading.en: The account says what a map lets a learner come to know, and that a learned procedure can pass on, but has no law relating representation to effort on later tasks. Its reading of meta-learning classifies orders functionally and claims no saving. This is the folder's distinctive claim, and it stands untaken and untested. [AI reading]

searched: live account: less explanation, less reasoning, cheaper, savings, payback, cost of learning, meta-learn, self-improv, self-modif, learning to learn, economy, abstraction, reuse; record-index by learn, map, composition, representation, compress, cost, effort
read: record titles of the knowing region

name.en: Thousands of useful workers

source.locator: Section 6; EVALUATION Five independent axes of scale

sense.en: Work should run across up to a thousand active workers, with queues, leases and backpressure, measured by accepted change and not activity. Benefit depends on task independence; an ownership conflict changes the boundary and is not remedied by another worker; useful saturation should be reported.

entries.quote: Sharding a queue does not prove semantic coordination scales.

reading.en: No law on how accepted work scales with the number of coordinating agents. 'Several optimizers drain by their joint capacity' concerns draw on a stock, not useful throughput, and would be a word match here. The account's reviewer and worker model has a roster of few and no queueing. [AI reading]

searched: live account: swarm, worker, multi-agent, thousands of, throughput, concurren, queue, backpressure, division of labo, overhead

name.en: Predict scope first; keep failed thresholds as results

source.locator: Provisional advancement gates; What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: Assistant-proposed standard: predict the affected set before implementation, seal outcomes, compare with tuned rivals, report losses as results. Every number is a provisional target; no measurement exists. Surprises must not be relabelled as locality after the fact.

entries.quote: Do not revise a failed threshold retrospectively and retain the original claim.

reading.en: Same practice as the account's frozen rules: verdict scored before the data, failure recorded beside the thesis. An agreement of method, not of a checked law. A frozen rule there fixes scoring, not that the rule reads its construct, a limit the folder states less exactly. The folder's own tests were not taken up; the account names it an application, correspondence not established. [AI reading]

says.en: Strength is the observations a claim excludes; standing is how far it is established. A thesis adds no theorem, a refutation removes none, and a failure stays recorded beside the thesis. A frozen rule fixes how a verdict is scored before the data, not that the rule reads the construct the verdict names.
Applications elsewhere (design programmes, not results; correspondence not established), naming evolving community swarms among them.

account_adds.en: The distinction between a frozen scoring rule and construct validity.

source_adds.en: The specific tests: ablations, matched baselines, unseen communities, the cost and quality gates. None is frozen or run in the account.

name.en: The goal: surpass the strongest alternative

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass; DECISIONS 2026-09-07

sense.en: Ren's direction is to surpass, not only learn from, existing systems. The assistant-authored reading: more useful change at lower total cost than the strongest practical alternatives, cumulative capability with communities keeping control. The folder ties any superiority claim to a workload, comparison, budget and period.

entries.quote: Success means a community can achieve more useful change with less repeated explanation

reading.en: The account does not take growing capability as a goal: no law of the dynamics gives a ranking, widening is a criterion and not a quantity to maximize, silent on mixed cases, and institutions have no prior licence to grow. The source does name what its comparison reads (cost per accepted change), so this is a frame kept as its own, not an error. [AI reading]

says.en: The direction is a criterion on which every positive weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. It is the question's generative direction only under the two premises, the continuation condition and C, neither asserted.

Ranking, order: a comparison of options as better or worse. No law of the dynamics gives one: the laws give how courses differ in what they admit, one widening another, the two keeping the same or mixed, with no premise.

Reading [AI, any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: the laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow; whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

account_adds.en: What a capability ranking would need: C or a premise in its place, and silence on mixed comparisons.

source_adds.en: A measured, competitive target with explicit rivals, which the account does not set itself.

name.en: A self-improving system must not grade itself

source.locator: Workloads and independence; ARCHITECTURE The organizing model

sense.en: Because the system may replace its own components and procedures, the plan keeps an independent evaluation reference: independent authors freeze outcomes, and the optimizing system cannot touch adjudication or cost accounting. Stated as test hygiene, not as a law of self-improving systems.

entries.quote: The optimizing system cannot edit sealed adjudication, cost accounting or reference history.

reading.en: Capture has this form: where winners write the next round's rule, the rule read monotonically from the share, the course locks; where the reading too is formed from the share, a change of it is absorbed. Keeping the reference outside the loop is one way out of those premises, though the account proves one sufficient exit only and not this design. That an actual self-improver's scoring so reads is a premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with selection not lowering a target's share under a rule favouring it and the rule read as a monotone function of the share, the course is locked from the step after its first reading step; only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration, under the stated monotone premises, the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course: a sufficient way out. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

account_adds.en: That a reading formed from what it scores can absorb any change made to it, and the step-exact conditions.

source_adds.en: The practical arrangement: sealed outcomes, independent authors, recorded adjudication.

name.en: Everyone happily making it more powerful

source.locator: Exchange 4, Ren

sense.en: Ren's founding picture: a space that never slows, where members keep adding apps, wallets, voting and badges until it becomes their 'os' and part of the culture. The folder's own README restates harmony as an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee and keeps real disagreement in its question, so the picture is a hope, not a claim of the design.

entries.quote: everyone just happily making it more and more powerful

reading.en: The account keeps what the picture leaves out: starting from relations does not remove rivalry, and positions total to zero. So where a badge or eligibility is read as relative position, it cannot raise everyone. That reading is mine and untested, and the divergence is with the picture, not with the folder's hedged design. No law here says a loss is a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting): across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls; no change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems: positive-sum structure and real conflict; mixed comparisons stay unranked.

account_adds.en: Real conflict as theorem, on the reading of position.

source_adds.en: The aspiration itself, and that a shared space can become part of a culture through use.

name.en: A community grows its own software into its culture

source.locator: The idea; The founding example; VISION Three demanding worlds

sense.en: The founding idea: members ask for changes where they use the software, agents help make them, and the space becomes a shared environment for work, play and coordination. Culture stays something people create and negotiate; the software should preserve their ability to do so.

entries.quote: A community can develop its own software continuously

reading.en: The account names this folder once, among applications: design programmes, not results, correspondence not established. That is where the founding idea went. Its only software claim is an assessment of selected LibreOffice and Narwhal histories, about what carried activity through partial reorganization, not members reshaping tools by request, nor software as culture. The folder's whole participatory research programme stands outside the account. [AI reading]

searched: live account: evolving community, swarm, software, culture, malleable, community OS, participatory, member request

name.en: Replay can overfit; unseen work tests generalization

source.locator: Section 3; EVALUATION What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: An assistant proposal: past changes can reject poor boundary candidates but cannot confirm good ones, since learning may memorize development fixtures. Promotion requires a trial and later evaluation on unseen changes, and the public fixture cannot serve as a sealed demonstration.

entries.quote: Historical replay can reject obviously poor candidates, but it can overfit.

reading.en: Same form on a named model: a program fits every old record yet answers the novel expression wrongly, and the novel expression's record exposes it; records only narrow candidates, and a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule. The model is a supplied, finite law family, not software or cognition. Promotion policy is not in the account. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (named codes and formation courses; witnesses; much supplied): for the collapsed code a program duplicating one argument fits the old records yet answers the novel expression wrongly; the novel expression's record exposes it, a course with spare parts rebuilds the right program, and without spare parts the error is recorded, not repaired.
Theorem (any type): records only narrow the candidates. A wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

account_adds.en: That a fresh record can expose an error without repairing it, when no spare parts are left.

source_adds.en: Promotion by trial, held-out communities and request families, and a periodic independent broader check.

name.en: A synthetic member cannot establish cultural fit

source.locator: Diagnostic measurements

sense.en: An assistant-proposed limit on evidence: product outcomes must be measured with members (task completion, correction time, adoption, abandonment), since an agent standing in for a member cannot establish fit or satisfaction. No such measurement has been made.

entries.quote: A synthetic agent impersonating a community member cannot establish cultural fit or member satisfaction.

reading.en: The account labels its own evidence the same way: its valuer experiments are AI personas, stated as role-play with human valuers untested. It is narrower than the source and differs in use: it runs such tests and reports verdicts with that label, where the source says they cannot establish the thing. No general law of what simulated people show. [AI reading]

says.en: Evidence for T5: VD1 (96 AI-persona valuers, frozen before any call), every frozen rule failed; VD2, some frozen rules passed and some failed. The judgments are role-play; human valuers are untested.

account_adds.en: A frozen test of what AI personas do, reported beside the label, including where every rule failed.

source_adds.en: The general limit, and its object: cultural fit and satisfaction in a community that uses the thing.

name.en: The ledger counts cost to the system, by price

source.locator: The primary question; VISION What success cannot be purchased by hiding

sense.en: An assistant proposal, thorough in its own frame: charge discovery, search, verification, failed attempts, migrations, human time and continuing maintenance, normalized by a pinned rate table. Hidden cost does not count as success. What is read is cost to the project and its members; a worker is temporary, and what a run draws beyond its price has no line.

entries.quote: Measure agent/infrastructure cost per accepted request

reading.en: The account would ask whose losses the comparison leaves out. Under the continuation condition (scope) every continuation's count; a ranking needs C (order); neither asserted, warrant open, no law says a loss is a harm. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown. So the account does not say workers or the draw matter, only that a report of what was built can omit what it depleted. The source's frame stays its own. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; its content beyond the self's presupposition extends scope to losses that return to no one; it ranks nothing. A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place. Neither is asserted.

Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, J1-J4, correspondence and improvement witnesses): overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts.
Reading [AI, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: A question the ledger does not ask: what its comparison omits, and who bears that, with the premises it would need named.

source_adds.en: A concrete, auditable ledger with charges for hidden work, which the account does not have for any activity.
